source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_leds" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i leds (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the LED OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_leds SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read BMC LED telemetry through SNMPv3 and compare named indicator states to the expected platform state.
original_method: Engineer configures SNMPv3 in WebUI and browses undefined `$target` using IReasoning; Criteria allow Net-SNMP.
manual_activity: Engineer configures SNMPv3/WebUI and, if the project adds physical correlation, supplies visual evidence; the source core is SNMP monitoring.
required_inputs: Whether physical visual correlation is required
safety_requirements: Read only; never set/identify LEDs or mask a real fault without separate approval.
Protect v3 secrets and reject v2c substitution.
Preserve raw typed states and actual alarm context.
Restore temporary configuration; no auto retry.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, query exact LED objects, compare enums and correlate supplied visual/fault evidence if required.
Do not operate WebUI or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve mapping/baseline, configure/restore v3 and provide any visual artifact.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic v2c grep cannot establish LED object identity or state encoding.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor MIB-resolved SNMPv3 LED objects with full typed responses.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each LED to its read-only MIB object and expected enum; query under a defined state and optionally correlate a timestamped photo.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds object/enum identity without changing source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents unrelated LED entries from passing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry may not prove physical illumination unless visual scope is added.

project_override_considerations: A project may require visual correlation; that added scope remains engineer-observed and must be reported separately.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria name different clients, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes explicit v3 to v2c/generic OID.

blocked_analysis.analysis: LED mapping/expected state are project inputs. After manual configuration, the source's read-only core can be automated.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps optional visual evidence distinct from source monitoring.

review_improvement: Defines LED identity/enum and avoids unapproved control actions.
independent_technical_reasoning: The named monitoring intent is clear. An engineer-provided MIB mapping makes software collection deterministic; manual configuration is setup, so the case is PARTIAL rather than blocked.
